description.narrative: Promote reconciliation; peaceful living together; social cohesion and active citizenship through the creation of a network of religious; community and civil society leaders as well as community organizations (CBOs; FBOs; local movements; etc…) with a focus on the element of sustainability and inter-organizational cooperation.TAMASOK MENA Core group will be the nucleus for the Arab Network for Continuous Peace or simply TAMASOK Network. TAMASOK MENA will build the capacity of the network’s members to be able to design; implement; monitor and evaluate their own initiatives; with an emphasis on rural areas and towns. Tamasok MENA handle the final year of the Child Friendly Spaces project; to ensure a proper exit plan. CFS is included in outcome 4.For the time being; TAMASOK MENA will be implemented only in Syria due to the current level of funding. With more fundraising; TAMASOK MENA is ready to be implemented in other countries and it can take over TAMASOK Lebanon after the end of its current funding by 2023. In this; the TAMASOK Network; hopefully; has the potential to cover many countries in MENA; where experiences are shared among activists; and religious actors; to serve peace and social cohesion in the Middle East.
